sample.orders.status: String. One of: cancelled, delivered, placed, returned, shipped.
sample.orders.channel: String. One of: app, store, web.
sample.orders.discount_code: String. One of: bf25, freeship, ramadan15, vip20, welcome10. Empty in 80% of source rows.
sample.payments.payment_id: Unique identifier for the payment transaction. String. Primary key.
sample.payments.order_ref: Reference number of the associated order. Integer. References orders.order_id.
sample.payments.paid_at: Timestamp when the payment was made. Timestamp. Source formats: %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.
sample.payments.method: Payment method used to process the transaction. String. One of: bank_transfer, card, cod, paypal_x, wallet.
sample.payments.amount: Amount paid in the specified currency. Decimal.
sample.payments.currency: Currency in which the amount was paid. String. One of: aed, sar, usd.
sample.payments.is_settled: Indicates whether the payment has been fully settled. Boolean.
